stem: What is the sum of the solutions to the equation \(|3x - 6| = 12\)?

explanation.A: Correct. The solutions are \(6\) and \(-2\), and \(6 + (-2) = 4\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(6 + 2\), the result of dropping the sign of the solution \(-2\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the only solution if the case \(3x - 6 = -12\) is missed; it is not a sum.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is one of the solutions, not the sum of both.

verify:
x = symbols('x', real=True)
sols = solve(Eq(Abs(3*x - 6), 12), x)
assert set(sols) == {6, -2}
ans = sum(sols)
assert ans == 4
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
